zh: 窄屏帧网格按宿主几何兜底，页宽标记固定 drawer 0、rail 56 与宿主侧栏宽度，侧栏收起或抽屉时不再被过期的行内值改成展开宽度，会话区不再塌成右侧窄条或闪现半白帧
en: Narrow frame grids fall back to the host's own geometry, page-width marks pin drawer 0, rail 56 and the sidebar's own width, a collapsed or drawer sidebar is no longer drawn at a stale expanded width, and the conversation no longer collapses into a right strip or flashes a half-white frame
